facts.text: Trailing-twelve-month revenue is ₹61,632 cr, +12% on the prior twelve months.
Trailing-twelve-month PAT is ₹10,987 cr, +5% on the prior twelve months.
Sep 2026 quarter: revenue ₹16,199 cr (+12% YoY), PAT ₹1,995 cr (−36% YoY), operating margin 29.3%.
Revenue has compounded at 7% over 10 years, 12% over 5 and 10% over 3.
Profit and revenue have compounded at a similar pace over 3 years (13% vs 10%).
Operating margin has compressed to 29.3% from 31.3% a year ago (−2.0 pp).
Borrowings are ₹3,241 cr against equity of ₹89,280 cr: debt/equity 0.04× (was 0.12× in Mar 2023).
Operating profit plus other income covers interest 54.2× over the last twelve months.
The cash conversion cycle has shortened to 228 days from 261 in Mar 2023 (payable days 194 → 232).
Promoters hold 52.7%, −1.8 pp over a year.
Foreign institutions hold 14.4%, −2.2 pp over a year.
Over 5 years, ₹52,570 cr of operating cash came from ₹66,541 cr of operating profit: 79% conversion; against PAT of ₹43,986 cr that is 1.2×.
Free cash flow was negative in 0 of the last 5 years; cumulative ₹41,320 cr, latest year ₹8,906 cr.
Capex ran at 6% of revenue in Mar 2026, about ₹3,513 cr (averaged 4% over the three years before).

business.what: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd is a global pharmaceutical company that develops, manufactures, and markets a wide range of branded and generic formulations, specialty medicines, and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) to address chronic, complex, and rare diseases globally.
business.geography: The company operates globally with 34% of revenue from India and 66% from international markets.

claims.claim: Gross margin was 80.8% for the quarter, higher than last year due to better product mix and currency tailwinds.
claims.quote: Gross margin was at 80.8% for the quarter, higher than the same period last year, largely on account of a better product mix and favorable currency tailwinds.

claims.claim: India business growth is robust, driven by volume expansion and new product launches.
claims.quote: Sun Pharma's 15.1% Pharmarack September '26 growth was driven primarily by strong volume expansions. Sun volume growth was 6.7% for the quarter compares favorably to IPM growth of 1.8%.

claims.claim: R&D spend is currently tracking lower than intended, but is expected to catch up in the second half of the year.
claims.quote: These numbers are tracking lower than our intended R&D spend, but we expect the second half of the year to catch up some of this R&D spend.

claims.claim: US business sales declined 8.2% due to lenalidomide erosion, though it grew 6.5% quarter-over-quarter.
claims.quote: Overall, the US business reported sales of USD455 million for the quarter, declining by 8.2%. This decline is largely due to lenalidomide erosion. On a quarter-over-quarter basis, the US business has grown by 6.5%.

claims.claim: Gross margin was at 80.5% for the quarter, higher than the same period last year, mainly on account of better product mix.
claims.quote: Gross margin was at 80.5% for the quarter, higher than the same period last year, mainly on account of better product mix.

claims.claim: Sun Pharma is ranked number 1 and holds 8.5% market share in the over INR2,527 billion Indian pharmaceutical market.
claims.quote: Sun Pharma is ranked number 1 and holds 8.5% market share in the over INR2,527 billion Indian pharmaceutical market as per Pharmarack MAT June 2026.

claims.claim: Sun's volume growth of 5.4% for the quarter compares favorably to IPM volume growth of 2%.
claims.quote: Sun's volume growth of 5.4% for the quarter compares favorably to IPM volume growth of 2%.

claims.claim: The U.S. business decline is largely due to Lenalidomide erosion, but also due to additional competition in certain products.
claims.quote: Our Innovative Medicines portfolio continued to grow, and this was offset by lower sales in the generic business, largely due to Lenalidomide erosion, but also due to additional competition in certain products.

claims.claim: The combined entity will have a net debt to EBITDA ratio of 2.3x.
claims.quote: Sun from a net cash positive position post this acquisition will get into a net debt by EBITDA of 2.3x.

claims.claim: The combined company will be the number one pharma company in four countries.
claims.quote: We will be number one pharma company in four countries

claims.claim: The combined company will be number three in women's health.
claims.quote: number three in women's health which is in contraceptive and fertility

claims.claim: The combined company will be number seven in biosimilars.
claims.quote: will be number seven biosimilars.

claims.claim: Organon's established product business in China has already undergone volume-based pricing.
claims.quote: majority of their EB portfolio in China has already undergone VBP, so that impact is already factored in.

claims.claim: Gross margins improved due to a better product mix.
claims.quote: Gross margin during the quarter was at 81%, higher than the same period last year, largely on account of better product mix.

claims.claim: Sun Pharma is the number one pharmaceutical company in India with an 8.4% market share.
claims.quote: Sun Pharma is ranked No. 1 and holds 8.4% market share in over Rs. 2,407 million Indian pharmaceuticals market as per Pharmarack MAT December 2025.

claims.claim: The company's volume growth in India outperformed the market.
claims.quote: Our volume growth of 6.3% for the quarter beat IPM volume growth which is at 1.2%.

claims.claim: The company maintains a strong net cash position.
claims.quote: Balance sheet continues to be strong with a net cash of $3.2 billion at the consolidated level.

claims.claim: US generic sales were impacted by specific competition for certain products.
claims.quote: It is really due to specific competition for certain products.

claims.claim: Sun Pharma is ranked number one in the Indian pharmaceutical market with 8.3% market share.
claims.quote: Sun Pharma is ranked number one and holds 8.3% market share in over INR2,350 billion Indian pharmaceutical market as per Pharmarack MAT September 2025.

claims.claim: India sales growth has been led by volumes and new product launches.
claims.quote: We're happy to note that on MAT basis, the sales growth has been led by volumes and new product launches versus the IPM growth, which is predominantly price led.

claims.claim: The company maintains a strong balance sheet with net cash of $2.9 billion.
claims.quote: Balance sheet continues to be strong with a net cash of $2.9 billion at a consolidated level.

claims.claim: Short-term borrowings taken for acquisition will be reduced over time.
claims.quote: This is a short-term borrowing that we have taken for the acquisition. And since it is also short term in nature, it will get evened out in the coming quarters.

claims.claim: Gross margin was favorable aided by lower material cost due to better product mix and a higher share of sales from the Innovative Medicines.
claims.quote: Gross margin was favorable aided by lower material cost due to better product mix and a higher share of sales from the Innovative Medicines.

claims.claim: India formulation sales growth has been led by volumes and new product launches versus the IPM growth, which is predominantly price-led.
claims.quote: We are happy to note that on a MAT basis, the sales growth has been led by volumes and new product launches versus the IPM growth, which is predominantly price-led.

claims.claim: US generics business is down quarter-over-quarter and year-over-year if we remove the impact of lenalidomide.
claims.quote: If we remove that impact, the U.S. generic business is down quarter-over-quarter and year-over-year.
